pages.text: All twelve enchantments are registered as normal enchantments, so they appear at the $(thing)enchanting table$() and can be applied with an $(thing)anvil$() and enchanted books.$(br2)Aspect enchantments are cheap (weight 5, level I). Enhancement and Resistance run to level V and cost more experience.

pages.title: Mob drops
pages.text: The reliable mid-game source is $(thing)elemental mobs$() themselves. When a mob with elemental attributes dies it can drop an $(thing)enchanted book$():$(br2)$(li)Base chance $(thing)50%$()$(li)$(thing)+10%$() per level of Looting$(br2)The book is randomly one of the three families, and its level scales with how strong that mob's own attributes were - a heavily enchanted elite drops a high-level book.

pages.title: What does not drop
pages.text: Elemental mobs are given their gear by the mod and that gear is set to $(thing)never drop$(). You will not be able to strip a Frost zombie of its enchanted chestplate.$(br2)Kill them for the books, not for the armour.

pages.title: Pack makers
pages.text: If you want a fixed item to always be elemental - a modded sword, a set of boss armour - use the $(thing)forced item$() system instead of enchanting by hand. See $(l:elementalcraft:config/forced)Forced Items & Attributes$(/l).
